raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Chose D) coldest temperature by focusing on the tropopause being cold within the troposphere, but across atmospheric layers the coldest region is near the mesopause (mesosphere). The best descriptor of the troposphere is that it has the greatest density (contains most of the atmosphere’s mass), i.e., option B.
